title: Action taken under repealed Act
description: Action taken under repealed Act deemed done under this Act

content.general_rule: Anything done or any action taken under the repealed Act shall, in so far as it is not inconsistent with the provisions of this Act, be deemed to have been done or taken under the corresponding provisions of this Act
content.exception: Shall be deemed to have been done or taken under the corresponding provisions of this Act
conditions: in so far as it is not inconsistent with the provisions of this Act
